qs.q: A phlebotomist is preparing to collect a basic metabolic panel from an inpatient. Which action must be performed immediately prior to drawing the sample to ensure patient safety?
o: Verifying sample volume requirement in the correct tube
Performing a system suitability test on the analyzer
Verifying patient identity verbally and checking wristbands
Running blank samples to check for chemical purity
qs.e: The identification process involves verbal patient confirmation, matching the patient ID to the request form, and labeling samples at the bedside. Tube volume and analyzer checks are separate technical steps.
